description: This Swift source file defines the TalkModeController class, which manages the state and behavior of the talk mode feature within an application. It handles enabling/disabling talk mode, updating phases and levels, pausing/unpausing, stopping speech, and exiting the mode.

classes.name: TalkModeController
classes.description: A final class that controls the state and transitions of the application's talk mode, including enabling/disabling, phases, pausing, and stopping speech.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the talk mode, updating the overlay, runtime, and voice wake listener accordingly.

methods.name: updatePhase
methods.description: Updates the current phase of talk mode and communicates the change to the overlay and external connection.

methods.name: updateLevel
methods.description: Updates the visual or logical level indicator in the overlay.

methods.name: setPaused
methods.description: Pauses or unpauses the talk mode, updating overlays and informing external components.

methods.name: togglePaused
methods.description: Toggles the paused state of the talk mode.

methods.name: stopSpeaking
methods.description: Stops the current speaking activity with a specified reason.

methods.name: exitTalkMode
methods.description: Exits the talk mode by disabling it in the application state.
